rules.penalty: Failure to deposit, transfer or return the deposit as required entitles the tenant to three times the deposit plus 5% interest, court costs and reasonable attorney's fees; the lessor forfeits the right to keep any of the deposit.
rules.title: Massachusetts security deposit limit and protections
rules.requirement: In Massachusetts, a security deposit cannot be more than one month's rent. The landlord must give receipts, keep it in a separate interest-bearing bank account in Massachusetts, pay you interest, and return it within 30 days after you move out, minus only allowed deductions.
rules.requirement_es: En Massachusetts, el depósito de seguridad no puede ser mayor que la renta de un mes. El propietario debe darle recibos, guardarlo en una cuenta bancaria separada con intereses en Massachusetts, pagarle intereses y devolverlo dentro de 30 días después de que usted se mude, menos solo las deducciones permitidas.

rules.title: Limits on upfront charges at start of tenancy
rules.requirement: In Massachusetts, before or at move-in a landlord or the landlord's agent can only charge you first month's rent, last month's rent, a security deposit up to one month's rent, and the cost of a new lock and key.
rules.requirement_es: En Massachusetts, antes o al mudarse, el propietario o su agente solo puede cobrarle la renta del primer mes, la renta del último mes, un depósito de seguridad de hasta un mes de renta y el costo de una nueva cerradura y llave.
